parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activities for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251) that have a canonical SMILES string and a PubMed ID or DOI. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, join target_dictionary on tid, join compound_records on record_id, join docs on doc_id, and join compound_structures on molregno (inner join). Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL5251, standard_type IC50, and standard_relation '='. Require canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL and (pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR doi IS NOT NULL). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows (do not deduplicate).
